Gabe: Ran a perf sweep this morning; nsys run shows a new stall pattern on multi-GPU. timeline attached: key issue seems kernel_selector_v2 launching lots of small <1ms kernels interleaved with ncclAllReduce, causing ring saturation and allreduce serialization.

Mina: which commit introduced selector_v2? any flag to revert?

Gabe: landed in the runtime patch yesterday (0a1b2c3). Repro is: ./run_inference.sh --tp=2 --batch=8 --seq=2048. nsys command I used:
```
nsys profile -o /tmp/run1.nsys --trace=nvtx,cuda --sample=none ./bin/infer --model=redwood-v1 --gpus=4
```
Look at perfetto: snippet shows alternating small kernels named fused_matmul_small_x and kv_cache_read (200-800us), and ncclAllReduce bursts ~2.3ms. Overlap is poor and NCCL spends time waiting.

Rosie: did we change the batching heuristic recently? splitting too many micro-batches could explain churn.

Jin: I checked the batching commit — introduced "batch-stitch" (tries to coalesce prompts but emits partial micro-batches to avoid OOM). When combined with selector_v2 it triggers more kernel churn instead of bigger fused kernels.

perf-bot: Profiling summary: GPU kernel churn +18%, NCCL idle +12%, end-to-end P50 latency +9% on this workload. Diff vs baseline attached.

Mina: hypothesis: selector_v2 favors low-latency kernels (good for single-GPU tail) but for TP it increases kernel count causing NCCL serialization -> regression for multi-GPU. We should add a selector signal that accounts for NCCL-friendly kernels (favor fewer larger matmuls).

Gabe: agreed. Quick experiment: set env KSEL_PREFERENCE=throughput and re-run. Locally that reduced P50 back to baseline and perfetto shows better NCCL overlap — allreduces overlap increased ~30%.

Rosie: can you paste the tiny timeline snippet you saw?
```
[time(ms)] kernel_name duration(us)
0.0 fused_matmul_small_x 450
0.5 kv_cache_read 210
0.8 fused_matmul_small_x 380
1.2 ncclAllReduce 2300
3.6 fused_matmul_large 1800
5.5 ncclAllReduce 2400
```

Jin: proposal: batching heuristic change + selector tweak. Heuristic: avoid emitting micro-batches with total token <512 for TP>1 while NCCL is active. Also try KV prefetch so multiple KV reads combine into one larger kernel (reduce kv_cache_read churn).

Mina: action items: Gabe to prototype adding NCCL-awareness to selector (simple cost model + penalty for kernel count), Jin to prototype batch threshold and KV prefetch, Rosie to run dedicated A/B regression tests and attach traces. I'll open an issue to track: #DOC-4789.

Gabe: opened infra ticket INF-231 and uploaded raw traces to perf bucket: https://perfetto/trace/abc123 (nsys + perfetto JSONs).

Rosie: also noticed an intermittent KV handshake stall on GPU3 (~1.1ms) right before an allreduce; suspect memory fence ordering + cross-GPU small memcpy. Leaving a note for eng-infra to check PCIe peer hops.

perf-bot: Created flamegraph snapshot: /artifacts/flame-2219876543.svg (attached). Heap of small kernels visible as hot thin spikes.

Jin: I'll try a patch to selector: prefer fused_matmul_large when TP>1 && microbatch_count>3, and run nsys with both KSEL_PREFERENCE=latency and =throughput to compare. Will post numbers.

Mina: thanks. keep updates short and attach the perfetto timeline when you have it. :thumbsup:
